newsitem.title: USA: Ferrofluidics Corp gets $10 mln in orders.
newsitem.headline: Ferrofluidics Corp gets $10 mln in orders.

text.p: Ferrofluidics Corp said on Friday it has received $10,000,000 in orders for its crystal growing systems from three international customers.
Two of the orders are from two separate Japanese wafer manufacturers, with the third from a European wafer manufacturer.

President and Chief Executive Officer Salvatore Vinciguerra said, "One order of approximately $4,000,000 represents a repeat order for the company's MCZ 150 8" crystal growing systems, which will be delivered to a production facility in Japan within this fiscal year.
"The second order of approximately $750,000 is a prototype of a joint development effort which is expected to lead to machines installed in the U.S. for use in production of 8" wafers," he said.

He said the third order was received from a European wafer manufacturer and was a repeat order for the company's CZ120 6" and 8" crystal growing system. "These machines will be installed at an expanded site in Europe," he added.
Ferrofluidics deals in ferrofluid (magnetic fluid) technology.
